records.title: Macroscopic scattering of cracks initiated at single impurity atoms
records.method: Learn-on-the-fly QM/MM with CASTEP/VASP PW91 near crack tip and SW elastic surroundings; experimental surface morphology
records.reported_comparison: At 1400 m/s the studied B site promotes a reconstruction and atomic-layer step; at about 1700 m/s the crack passes before reconstruction develops. Only one of four inequivalent B sites produces stepping in the studied geometry.
records.interpretation: Chemical site and the competition between reconstruction and crack transit times both matter.
